    # Near-limit inputs (expected values from a reference solution; see test_audit/)
    def _big(seed, scale=1.0):
        import random
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        L = max(5, int(26 * scale))
        letters = [chr(65 + i) for i in range(26)]
        rng.shuffle(letters)
        letters = letters[:L]
        if seed % 3 == 0:
            names = [a + b for a in letters for b in letters]
        else:
            small = 1 if seed % 3 == 1 else 2
            g1 = set(letters[small:])
            p = 1.0 if seed % 3 == 1 else 0.9
            names = []
            for a in letters:
                for b in letters:
                    if (a in g1) == (b in g1) or (a in g1 and rng.random() < p):
                        names.append(a + b)
        rng.shuffle(names)
        return (len(names), names)
    assert candidate(*_big(1)) == 25
    assert candidate(*_big(2)) == 41
    assert candidate(*_big(3)) == 1
